title: Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Discount Rate Page and Discount Cap
content:
Discounts on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy are percentages of the base premium, set by the coverage package. The sum of all discount percentages applied to one policy is capped at the package's discount cap.

## Discount rates by package

| Discount | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Multi-car (household vehicle count two or more) | 8% | 10% | 12% | 15% | 18% | 20% |
| Multi-policy (customer also holds a Cardinal homeowners, condominium or renters policy) | 0% | 5% | 7% | 10% | 12% | 15% |
| Homeowner (named insured owns the residence) | 0% | 3% | 5% | 5% | 7% | 8% |
| Paperless (customer enrolled in paperless documents) | 2% | 2% | 3% | 3% | 3% | 4% |
| Good student, per qualifying rated driver | 5% | 8% | 10% | 12% | 15% | 15% |
| Defensive driver, per qualifying rated driver | 3% | 5% | 5% | 5% | 8% | 10% |
| Claim-free | 0% | 0% | 5% | 7% | 10% | 12% |
| Cap on the sum of all discount percentages | 20% | 25% | 30% | 35% | 40% | 45% |

## Qualification thresholds by package

| Threshold | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Good student minimum grade point average (4.0 scale) | 3.0 | 3.0 | 3.0 | 3.0 | 3.0 | 3.0 |
| Good student oldest qualifying age, years | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Defensive driver minimum age, years | 55 | 55 | 55 | 55 | 55 | 55 |
| Months after course completion during which the defensive driver discount applies | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |

## Qualification notes

- **Good student.** A full-time student qualifies at a grade point average of at least 3.0 and up to age 24, the oldest qualifying age. A driver aged 24 on the rating date still qualifies; a driver aged 25 does not.
- **Defensive driver.** The rated driver must be at least 55 and must have completed an approved defensive driving course within the 36 calendar months before the rating date.
- **Claim-free.** Applies when no rated driver has a chargeable at-fault accident in the lookback and the customer has no paid physical damage claim in the lookback. On Cardinal Auto Essential and Cardinal Auto Basic its rate is 0%.
- **Multi-policy and homeowner.** On Cardinal Auto Essential both rates are 0%, so neither reduces the premium on that package.

## Worked illustration of the cap (hypothetical inputs)

A Cardinal Auto Basic policy qualifying for multi-car (10%), multi-policy (5%), homeowner (3%), paperless (2%) and one good student (8%) sums to 28%. The Cardinal Auto Basic cap is 25%, so 25% is the discount percentage used. The same qualifications on Cardinal Auto Premier sum to 20 plus 15 plus 8 plus 4 plus 15, which is 62%, and are held to that package's cap of 45%.
